meta.name: slack-gif-creator
meta.description: Knowledge and utilities for creating animated GIFs optimized for Slack. Provides constraints, validation tools, and animation concepts. Use when users request animated GIFs for Slack like "make me a GIF of X doing Y for Slack."

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 制作适合 Slack 的动画 GIF
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果经常在 Slack 中分享有趣的动画 GIF
copy.tagline_en: Create animated GIFs optimized for Slack
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you often share animated GIFs in Slack

howto.what: 安装后，Claude 能根据你的描述，用代码生成适合 Slack 的动画 GIF，包括尺寸、帧率、颜色等优化，并支持用户上传图片作为素材。
howto.when: 当你要求 Claude 为 Slack 制作动画 GIF，例如说“给我做一个 X 做 Y 的 GIF 用于 Slack”时触发。

say.text: 帮我做一个旋转的星星 GIF，用于 Slack 表情。
say.note: Claude 会生成 128x128 的 GIF。

say.text: 把这张图片做成弹跳动画 GIF，适合 Slack 消息。
say.note: Claude 会处理上传的图片并生成动画。

say.text: 做一个心跳脉冲的 GIF，尺寸 480x480。
say.note: Claude 会生成消息尺寸的 GIF。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude can generate animated GIFs optimized for Slack based on your description, including dimensions, frame rate, colors, and supports user-uploaded images as source material.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you ask Claude to create an animated GIF for Slack, e.g., "make me a GIF of X doing Y for Slack."

say_en.text: Make a spinning star GIF for Slack emoji.
Animate this image into a bouncing GIF for Slack messages.
say_en.note: Claude will process the uploaded image and create animation.

say_en.text: Create a heartbeat pulse GIF, size 480x480.
say_en.note: Claude will generate a message-sized GIF.
